info.title: Kinship API
info.description: Every route of Kinship, the single-owner relationship notebook. No sign-in: every call acts as the configured owner, and the app answers only on the machine it runs on. Send JSON with `Content-Type: application/json` (photo uploads are multipart). Errors answer `{ error }`, plus `issues` on validation failures. Deletes move records to the trash (`/api/trash` restores them). Generated by `npm run api:spec` from lib/openapi/routes.ts; never edit it by hand.

post.summary: The MCP endpoint for AI agents (Streamable HTTP, stateless, JSON answers)
post.description: Speaks the Model Context Protocol: point an MCP client at this address. Each request is one JSON-RPC message (or a batch) and is answered as JSON; there are no sessions. The body is at most 1 MB. Refusals by the protocol itself (JSON that is not JSON-RPC, a missing `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`) answer a JSON-RPC error object. Tools: `tools/list`.
